signal_evidence.credit_quality_trend: Excluding the impact of delinquent loan sales, the estimated all-in annualized net charge-off rate was 3.7%, a 70 basis point decrease from last quarter driven by an improvement in the underlying credit performance.
signal_evidence.services_demand: We added a record 1.1 million new members in Q2, increasing total members 35% year-over-year to a total of 15.8 million members... we also added a record 2.2 million new products.
signal_evidence.capex_direction: There are just too many large attractive growth areas for us to invest versus adding even more profitability... this year, we've launched a number of things that were never in our 2026 plan: Big Business Banking, SMB, SoFi USD, SoFi Crypto.
signal_evidence.pricing_power: Our net interest margin was 5.98% for the quarter, up 4 basis points sequentially... we continue to expect a healthy net interest margin above 5% for the foreseeable future.
signal_evidence.management_tone_shift: Q2 marks a clear inflection point in our strategy... the benefits of the strategy are no longer theoretical or leap of faith. They are 100% in our control via disciplined execution.
